items.title: Is Ciena's Pricing Power Real, Or Just A Parts Shortage?
items.summary: Ciena (CIEN) trades near $334, a little over half its 52-week high, and the easy read on an AI networking supplier down that far is that it has gone on sale. It is still up more than 150% over the past year, and the company has just guided fiscal 2027 to record profitability. The risk here is not demand. It is what the new prices are attached to.

items.title: CIEN Targets 30% Revenue Growth Through 2029 — Peers COHR, GLW And AAOI Rally After Guidance
items.summary: The networking company also expects adjusted operating margins of 32% to 35% and free cash flow margins of about 20% by fiscal 2029.

items.title: US Stock Market Today: S&P 500 Futures Fall As Inflation And Rate Worries Build

August consumer prices rose 0.4% for the month, driven by gasoline and housing, while the yearly rate eased to 2.4%, the lowest since early 2021.
